classification: PACKAGING REPAIR, NOT A CONTROL MODIFICATION

what_was_wrong.summary: the stored checkpoint package was missing the tokenizer and chat-template assets the frozen evaluator requires, so no prompt could be rendered
what_was_wrong.observed: ValueError: Cannot use chat template functions because tokenizer.chat_template is not set
what_was_wrong.found_by: attempt 7, Stage 3, 2026-08-15, $0.4500 — sa characterized, sb failed
what_was_wrong.why_the_gate_passed: Stage 0 verifies weights sha256, probe id, observed protocol fingerprint, seed, initialization digest and re-runs the strict reconstruction. None of that reads tokenizer assets, so a checkpoint can be fully identity-verified and still be impossible to evaluate.

source_of_truth.what: the canonical initialization both controls were trained from
source_of_truth.why_not_sa: sa is byte-identical for these three files, but the canonical initialization is the origin; copying from a sibling control would make one control's package depend on another's.

verified.identical_to_sa: yes for all three files; independently corroborated by the attempt-7 engine probe, which recorded chat_template_sha256 3802169b… for the run that worked

note: sa needed no repair; its package already carried all three assets with these exact hashes. Attempt 7's sa result remains valid partial evidence and must not be combined with a later sb result: the next successful continuation runs the complete path again, fresh sa and fresh sb.
